title: Wish it wasn’t broken
text: Wish it wasn’t broken. I bought this product to store bird seed. I like the spout top which would make it easy to fill the bird feeder. The product itself is fine however, upon opening the box I noticed that one of the plastic pieces that should snap the lid closed onto the base was hanging on by a thread. Clearly there was very little quality control while picking this item for my order.
